description: The figure is a two-ring donut pie chart summarizing “Win rate (%)” for three language models, showing 3 slices in total with labels connected by leader lines; GPT‑4o is the dominant slice at about 98.4% (shown as a large dark blue segment on the outer ring and a large dark red segment on the inner ring), LLaMA is about 3.2% (a small light blue segment near the top of the outer ring), and Mistral is about 1.2% (a very thin light/white segment near the top of the inner ring). The center contains the text “Win rate (%)”, the percentages are presented as external text labels rather than inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond the dual-ring styling; the slices appear arranged with the largest segment spanning most of the circle and the smaller segments clustered near the top.
